topic: Bernard Baars Global Workspace Theory: Why an 86-Billion-Neuron Parallel Brain Broadcasts Only One Conscious Scene at a Time Through Frontoparietal Networks (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Multi-laboratory adversarial testing in Nature across two hundred fifty-six volunteers confirming widespread cortical broadcast ignition whenever hidden visual inputs cross into conscious awareness.
